mapper.select: SELECT A.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, A.CASH_ID CASH_ID, A.CASH_TYPE_2 CASH_TYPE_2, B.VDATE_UNADJUST VDATE_UNADJUST, B.MDATE_UNADJUST MDATE_UNADJUST, B.VDATE VDATE, B.MDATE MDATE, B.PAY_DATE PAY_DATE, B.PRIN_AMT PRIN_AMT, B.INT_AMT INT_AMT, B.CASH_AMT CASH_AMT, B.INT_PRIN_AMT INT_PRIN_AMT FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.BRANCH = 0 ORDER BY B.MDATE

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, A.CASH_ID CASH_ID, A.CASH_TYPE_2 CASH_TYPE_2, B.EFF_DATE EFF_DATE, B.BASIS BASIS, B.YIELD YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID where 1=1 AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.BRANCH = 0 AND A.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' ORDER BY B.EFF_DATE DESC

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, A.CASH_ID CASH_ID, A.CASH_TYPE_2 CASH_TYPE_2， B.EFF_DATE EFF_DATE, B.PAY_CYCLE PAY_CYCLE, B.CALC_RULE CALC_RULE, B.FIRST_PAY_DATE FIRST_PAY_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID where A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.BRANCH = 0 AND A.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' ORDER BY B.EFF_DATE DESC

select * from ( SELECT A.OCODE OCODE, A.OTYPE OTYPE, A.GRADEORGID GRADEORGID, A.GRADEDATE GRADEDATE, A.MSTRATINGRESULT01 GRADERESULT FROM (SELECT A.OCODE AS OCODE, A.OTYPE AS OTYPE, A.INNEROUTER AS INNEROUTER, A.GRADEORGID AS GRADEORGID, A.GRADEDATE AS GRADEDATE, A.NOTICEDATE AS NOTICEDATE, A.SHORTLONGTERM AS SHORTLONGTERM, A.MSTRATINGRESULT01 AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, A.MSTRATINGRESULT02 AS MSTRATINGRESULT02, A.INPUTTYPE AS INPUTTYPE, A.GRADEEXPECTATION AS GRADEEXPECTATION, A.DIRECTIONCHANGE AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, A.ISSUERRATETYPE AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM ( SELECT MBCR.O_CODE AS OCODE, MBCR.O_TYPE AS OTYPE, '01' AS INNEROUTER, MBCR.GRADE_ORG_ID AS GRADEORGID, MBCR.GRADE_DATE AS GRADEDATE, MBCR.NOTICE_DATE AS NOTICEDATE, MBCR.SHORT_LONG_TERM AS SHORTLONGTERM, MBCR.GRADE_RESULT AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, MRM.GRADE_RESULT_ST AS MSTRATINGRESULT02, MBCR.INPUT_TYPE AS INPUTTYPE, MBCR.GRADE_EXPECTATION AS GRADEEXPECTATION, MBCR.DIRECTION_CHANGE AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, MBCR.ISSUER_RATE_TYPE AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING MBCR LEFT JOIN MST_RATING_MATCH MRM ON MBCR.GRADE_RESULT = MRM.GRADE_RESULT_OR UNION ALL SELECT MICR.O_CODE AS OCODE, MICR.O_TYPE AS OTYPE, '02' AS INNEROUTER, MICR.GRADE_ORG_ID AS GRADEORGID, MICR.GRADE_DATE AS GRADEDATE, NULL AS NOTICEDATE, NULL AS SHORTLONGTERM, MICR.GRADE_RESULT AS MSTRATINGRESULT01, MRM1.GRADE_RESULT_ST AS MSTRATINGRESULT02, MICR.INPUT_TYPE AS INPUTTYPE, NULL AS GRADEEXPECTATION, NULL AS DIRECTIONCHANGE, NULL AS ISSUERRATETYPE FROM MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING MICR LEFT JOIN MST_RATING_MATCH MRM1 ON MICR.GRADE_RESULT = MRM1.GRADE_RESULT_OR) A)A WHERE A.OCODE = #{ocode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.OTYPE = #{otype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.GRADEORGID = #{gradeorgId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.GRADEDATE <= #{searchDate, jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY A.GRADEDATE DESC) where ROWNUM =1
SELECT A.SECID SECID FROM (select A.SECID,A.ISSUERSHORT from INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO A)A WHERE A.ISSUERSHORT = #{issuer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
